headline: Steady growth momentum, margin outlook improving

highlights: EBITDA margin expansion of 180bps YoY was supported by higher utilisation of its established lab network and productivity improvement initiatives.
The integration of Core is progressing well and its EBITDA margins have scaled to double digit.
Management revised its FY27 revenue growth guidance to ~16% (earlier 14–15%) and EBITDA margin is expected to expand 160–180bps in H2FY27.
Revenue in-line; operating leverage boosts margins Q2FY27 grew 15.8% YoY (+10.4% QoQ) to INR 5bn (I-Sec: INR 4.9bn) led by healthy patient volumes (~10%) and better realisation (~5%).
valuation: Source: SES ESG, I-sec research Earnings Revisions (%) FY27E FY28E Revenue 0.3 1.2 EBITDA 1.9 0.4 EPS 3.1 0.4 Previous Reports 28-08-2026: Company update 06-08-2026: Q1FY27 results review Metropolis Healthcare | Results Update | 06 November 2026 India | Institutional Equity Research 2 Valuation and risks Metropolis is increasingly positioning itself as a high-end specialty diagnostics player.
The stock currently trades at valuations of 44.0x FY27E and 36.1x FY28E earnings and EV/EBITDA multiple of 23.4x FY27E and 19.4x FY28E.
We maintain BUY on the stock with an unchanged DCF-based target price of INR 675.
